## Dossiers

### NestLens Orbit

**LabelNest India Pvt Ltd** · Bengaluru, India · founded 2025

- **Pricing.** ₹75,000 / ₹99,000 / ₹1,25,000 / ₹2,50,000 per year (Orbit Launch/Starter/Growth/Scale); Orbit PM ₹2,499/mo; Orbit OS ₹29,999/mo
- **Scope.** incubation OS: intake, screening, evaluation, cohorts, mentors, MOM transcription, grant ledger, compliance calendar
- **What makes it different.** Indian-language MOM transcription (Sarvam); NIDHI/DST-TBI/BIRAC/RKVY ledgers
- **Where it is weak.** No verifiable Indian customer; zero third-party reviews; internal pricing conflict
- **Customer evidence.** `UNKNOWN` — none found
- **Third-party reviews.** 0
- **Threat.** HIGH
- **Source.** <https://labelnest.in/nestlens/orbit> — retrieved 2026-10-19, `VERIFIED_LIVE`

### EcoSync

**Opernova Technologies LLP** · India (registered LLP) · founded Not disclosed

- **Pricing.** Login-gated; plans configured per deployment, monthly/weekly/yearly
- **Scope.** incubator CRM+ERP: programs, applications, weighted panel evaluation, office space, funding source-to-tranche, task boards
- **What makes it different.** India-first rails (INR/GST/TDS/UPI/IST); funding over-allocation blocked at entry; 12-status audit trail
- **Where it is weak.** VENDOR_CLAIM only - no third-party verification; no SOC 2 / ISO 27001 (self-disclosed); first customer is also the reference
- **Customer evidence.** `VENDOR_CLAIM` — TBI-KIET (KIET Group of Institutions)
- **Third-party reviews.** 0
- **Threat.** HIGH
- **Source.** <https://www.ecosync.co/> — retrieved 2026-10-19, `VERIFIED_LIVE`

### IncubatX

**IncubatX** · India · founded 2026

- **Pricing.** Foundation ₹10,000–15,000/mo · Accelerator ₹30,000–40,000/mo · Executive AI ₹50,000–60,000/mo · Media Kit add-on ₹15,000/mo
- **Scope.** incubator/accelerator OS: cohorts, funding, CSR, matchmaking, impact dashboard
- **What makes it different.** Published INR price list; top of the observed Indian envelope
- **Where it is weak.** Founded 2026, no track record; claims 240+ schemes but matches on sector/stage, not TRL; zero customers
- **Customer evidence.** `UNKNOWN` — none found
- **Third-party reviews.** 0
- **Threat.** HIGH
- **Source.** <https://incubatx.com/> — retrieved 2026-10-19, `VERIFIED_LIVE`

### Accubate

**Cunomial** · India · founded Not disclosed

- **Pricing.** $149/user/month (aggregator); own site publishable-only
- **Scope.** innovation programme management; Enterprise multi-site is genuinely the closest in the set
- **What makes it different.** Only competitor with a real review base (26 Capterra, 4.8); multi-site architecture
- **Where it is weak.** Per-user pricing collapses institutional ACV; documentation-poor; broken pricing page; scored 2/5 on AI by a competitor
- **Customer evidence.** `NAMED_LOGO` — NSRCEL, NASSCOM, TCS, Hero, KPMG, Accenture
- **Third-party reviews.** 26
- **Threat.** HIGH
- **Source.** <https://www.getapp.za.com/software/2062553/accubate> — retrieved 2026-10-19, `AGGREGATOR`

### VentureLink

**VentureLink** · Toronto, Canada · founded Not stated

- **Pricing.** Core $180/mo · Emails $30/mo · Events $30/mo · Jobs $15/mo · Onboarding $500 once
- **Scope.** innovation ecosystem OS: intake, external judges, cohorts, mentors, desks, funding, flows automation, 760+ integrations
- **What makes it different.** The ONLY named university-institution reference found in the entire category; workflow automation at depth
- **Where it is weak.** Data residency is CANADA - fails Indian data-residency procurement; SOC 2 'in progress'; $225/mo still a real cost for a government TBI
- **Customer evidence.** `NAMED_REFERENCE` — ICUBE, University of Toronto (Ignacio Mongrell, Assistant Director)
- **Third-party reviews.** 0
- **Threat.** HIGH
- **Source.** <https://venturelink.co/> — retrieved 2026-10-19, `VERIFIED_LIVE`

### RiserNest

**RiserNest** · Rotterdam, Netherlands · founded 2024

- **Pricing.** €399/mo (≤30 teams) · €799/mo (30–100) · €1,500/mo (100+), ex-VAT; per-user tiers €40/70/120 also shown
